overview: The encryption response closes the RSA handshake and is the last plaintext packet on the connection, so anticheats never flag it. Corpus hits are registrations: Negativity lists ENCRYPTION_BEGIN_IN and ENCRYPTION_BEGIN_OUT in its PacketType enum, Artemis maps PacketLoginClientEncryptionBegin in its PacketRepository, and intave's ServerboundConfirmEncryption belongs to Intave's own cloud-control channel with its own cipher pipeline, not to the Minecraft login exchange. After this packet the stream is AES-encrypted and every later anticheat sees ciphertext.
